script_text: Stop, Pisces: Saturn is pressing its seal onto your destiny line. On June 17, 2026, Saturn in your 1st House is conjunct the North Node in Pisces, while Mars in your 3rd House sextiles Saturn, steadying your watery, Neptune-ruled nature. With Neptune in your 2nd House, Jupiter in Cancer trines it, opening a money-and-pleasure channel. If you're single, you attract someone sensual, protective, and financially serious through a friend or creative circle. If committed, avoid turning a practical concern into a cold shoulder; one honest budget talk softens the mood. Career-wise your 10th House benefits as Saturn in the 1st strengthens your authority: a manager or client backs a proposal, involving real estate, food, childcare, or design. Expect a message that changes your spending plan, and a second chance with a collaborator appears by evening. Avoid hiding invoices, because one receipt comes back before midnight. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
